section_title: Understanding Real Numbers and Their Classification
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-13.2s) - Introduction to real numbers
title = Text("Understanding Real Numbers", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
number_line = NumberLine(
    x_range=[-5, 5],
    include_numbers=True,
    unit_size=1
).shift(DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(number_line), run_time=3)

examples = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{Lengths}"),
    MathTex(r"\text{Temperatures}"),
    MathTex(r"\text{Speeds}")
).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1).next_to(number_line, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(examples), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.2)  # Complete 13.2s segment

# Segment 2 (13.2-22.9s) - Continuous nature visualization
points = VGroup(*[
    Dot(number_line.n2p(i/2), radius=0.05, color=BLUE) 
    for i in range(-10, 11)
])
zoomed_points = VGroup(*[
    Dot(number_line.n2p(i/4), radius=0.04, color=RED)
    for i in range(-20, 21)
])

self.play(FadeIn(points), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Transform(points.copy(), zoomed_points),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(3.7)  # Complete 9.7s segment

# Segment 3 (22.9-32.5s) - Properties visualization
number_types = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{Positive: } +2, +\pi, +\frac{3}{4}"),
    MathTex(r"\text{Negative: } -1, -\sqrt{2}, -\frac{5}{3}"),
    MathTex(r"\text{Zero: } 0")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(number_line, UP, buff=1)

self.play(
    Write(number_types),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(5.7)  # Complete 9.7s segment

# Segment 4 (32.5-54.8s) - Whole numbers
whole_numbers = VGroup(
    Text("Whole Numbers", font_size=36),
    MathTex(r"\{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, ...\}")
).arrange(DOWN).to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP)

whole_dots = VGroup(*[
    Dot(number_line.n2p(i), color=GREEN, radius=0.08)
    for i in range(6)
])

self.play(
    FadeOut(number_types),
    Write(whole_numbers),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    FadeIn(whole_dots),
    run_time=3
)

example = VGroup(
    Text("Example:", font_size=32),
    Text("0 apples", font_size=32)
).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5).next_to(whole_numbers, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(example), run_time=3)
self.wait(13.3)  # Complete 22.3s segment

# Segment 5 (54.8-85.3s) - Rational numbers
rational_def = MathTex(
    r"\text{Rational Numbers: }\frac{p}{q},\text{ where }p,q\in\mathbb{Z},q\neq 0"
).to_edge(RIGHT).shift(UP)

examples = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"-\frac{2}{5}"),
    MathTex(r"0.2"),
    MathTex(r"\frac{7}{3}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(rational_def, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(
    FadeOut(whole_dots),
    FadeOut(whole_numbers),
    FadeOut(example),
    Write(rational_def),
    run_time=4
)

self.play(
    Write(examples[0]),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(examples[1]),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(examples[2]),
    run_time=2
)

rational_points = VGroup(*[
    Dot(number_line.n2p(i/3), color=YELLOW, radius=0.06)
    for i in range(-15, 16)
])

self.play(FadeIn(rational_points), run_time=3)
self.wait(17.5)  # Complete 30.5s segment

# Segment 1 (0-13.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("A cornerstone of number theory", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 2 (13.2-27.4s) - Definition
definition_box = VGroup(
    Text("Every integer > 1 is either:", font_size=36),
    Text("• A prime number", font_size=32),
    Text("• A unique product of primes", font_size=32)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    title.animate.scale(0.7).to_edge(UP),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(definition_box), run_time=4)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 3 (27.4-43.2s) - Example with 12
number_12 = MathTex("12").scale(2)
arrow1 = Arrow(LEFT * 3, RIGHT * 3)
factors_12 = MathTex("2 \\times 2 \\times 3").scale(2)

factor_group = VGroup(number_12, arrow1, factors_12).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5)
factor_group.move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(definition_box),
    Write(number_12),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Create(arrow1), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(factors_12), run_time=3)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 4 (43.2-55.9s) - Uniqueness demonstration
alt_factorizations = VGroup(
    MathTex("12 = 3 \\times 2 \\times 2"),
    MathTex("12 = 2 \\times 3 \\times 2"),
    MathTex("12 = 2 \\times 2 \\times 3")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(factor_group, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(
    Write(alt_factorizations[0]),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(alt_factorizations[1]),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(alt_factorizations[2]),
    run_time=2
)

highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(alt_factorizations[2], color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(highlight_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 5 (55.9-82.8s) - Importance and applications
applications = VGroup(
    Text("Applications:", font_size=36),
    Text("• Finding HCF", font_size=32),
    Text("• Computing LCM", font_size=32),
    Text("• Number Theory", font_size=32),
    Text("• Cryptography", font_size=32)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(factor_group),
    FadeOut(alt_factorizations),
    FadeOut(highlight_box),
    run_time=2
)

applications.move_to(ORIGIN)
self.play(Write(applications), run_time=4)

final_box = SurroundingRectangle(applications, color=BLUE, buff=0.5)
self.play(Create(final_box), run_time=2)

importance = Text("Foundation of Number Theory", font_size=36).next_to(final_box, DOWN)
self.play(Write(importance), run_time=3)
self.wait(15.9)

section_title: Proof of Irrationality: The Case of Root 2
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-10.7s) - Intro to root 2 irrationality
title = Text("The Irrationality of √2", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
root_two = MathTex(r"\sqrt{2}", font_size=72).shift(UP)
question = Text("Is this number rational or irrational?", font_size=36).next_to(root_two, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(root_two), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(question), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 2 (10.7-18.8s) - Proof by contradiction intro
proof_text = Text("Proof by Contradiction", color=YELLOW, font_size=42)
proof_text.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(
    FadeOut(root_two),
    FadeOut(question),
    Write(proof_text),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(6.1)

# Segment 3 (18.8-33.5s) - Core idea explanation
assumption = Text("Assumption", color=BLUE, font_size=36).shift(LEFT * 4 + UP * 1)
arrow = Arrow(assumption.get_right(), ORIGIN + UP * 1, color=BLUE)
contradiction = Text("Contradiction!", color=RED, font_size=36).shift(RIGHT * 4 + UP * 1)
x_mark = Text("✗", color=RED, font_size=72).next_to(contradiction, DOWN)

self.play(
    Write(assumption),
    Create(arrow),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Write(contradiction),
    FadeIn(x_mark),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 4 (33.5-44.2s) - Conclusion of contradiction logic
conclusion = Text("Therefore, assumption must be false!", font_size=36)
conclusion.next_to(arrow, DOWN, buff=1)
conclusion_box = SurroundingRectangle(conclusion, color=GREEN)

self.play(
    Write(conclusion),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Create(conclusion_box),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 5 (44.2-82.7s) - Setting up initial assumption
self.play(
    FadeOut(assumption),
    FadeOut(arrow),
    FadeOut(contradiction),
    FadeOut(x_mark),
    FadeOut(conclusion),
    FadeOut(conclusion_box),
    FadeOut(proof_text),
    run_time=2
)

assumption = MathTex(
    r"\sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}",
    r"\text{ where }",
    r"p, q \text{ are integers}",
    font_size=42
).shift(UP * 2)

conditions = VGroup(
    Text("• q ≠ 0", font_size=36),
    Text("• p and q have no common factors", font_size=36)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).next_to(assumption, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(assumption), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Write(conditions[0]),
    Write(conditions[1]),
    run_time=3
)

highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(
    VGroup(assumption, conditions),
    color=YELLOW,
    buff=0.5
)
self.play(Create(highlight_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(28.6)

section_title: Applying Prime Factorization to Find HCF and LCM
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-12.7s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding HCF and LCM using Prime Factorization", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Using Prime Factors to Calculate", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
hcf_def = Text("HCF: Highest Common Factor", font_size=28, color=BLUE).shift(UP)
lcm_def = Text("LCM: Least Common Multiple", font_size=28, color=GREEN).next_to(hcf_def, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(hcf_def), Write(lcm_def), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 2 (12.7-22.3s) - Introduce numbers
numbers = MathTex("72 \\text{ and } 120", font_size=48).shift(DOWN)
box72 = SurroundingRectangle(numbers[0][0:2], buff=0.1, color=BLUE)
box120 = SurroundingRectangle(numbers[0][6:9], buff=0.1, color=GREEN)

self.play(FadeOut(subtitle, hcf_def, lcm_def), run_time=1)
self.play(Write(numbers), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(box72), Create(box120), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 3 (22.3-38.6s) - Prime factorizations
fact72 = MathTex("72 = 2^3 \\times 3^2", color=BLUE).shift(UP + LEFT * 3)
fact120 = MathTex("120 = 2^3 \\times 3 \\times 5", color=GREEN).shift(UP + RIGHT * 3)

self.play(
    FadeOut(box72, box120),
    ReplacementTransform(numbers, VGroup(fact72, fact120)),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(13.2)

# Segment 4 (38.6-61.4s) - Calculate HCF
hcf_title = Text("HCF Calculation:", color=BLUE).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
hcf_work = MathTex(
    "\\text{Common factors: }",
    "2^3", "\\times", "3^1",
    "=", "24"
).next_to(hcf_title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(hcf_title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(hcf_work[0:4]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(hcf_work[4:]), run_time=2)
self.wait(15.9)

# Segment 5 (61.4-96.0s) - Calculate LCM
lcm_title = Text("LCM Calculation:", color=GREEN).shift(DOWN * 2.5)
lcm_work = MathTex(
    "\\text{Highest powers: }",
    "2^3", "\\times", "3^2", "\\times", "5^1",
    "=", "360"
).next_to(lcm_title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(lcm_title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(lcm_work[0:6]), run_time=4)
self.play(Write(lcm_work[6:]), run_time=2)

# Highlight final results
hcf_box = SurroundingRectangle(hcf_work[-1], buff=0.1, color=BLUE)
lcm_box = SurroundingRectangle(lcm_work[-1], buff=0.1, color=GREEN)
self.play(
    Create(hcf_box),
    Create(lcm_box),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(24.5)

section_title: Solving Word Problems with HCF and LCM
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-14.7s) - Introduction
title = Text("Word Problems with HCF & LCM", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Applying these concepts to real scenarios", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
hcf_text = Text("HCF", color=BLUE, font_size=36).shift(LEFT * 3)
lcm_text = Text("LCM", color=GREEN, font_size=36).shift(RIGHT * 3)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(hcf_text), Write(lcm_text), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 2 (14.7-34.5s) - Circular track scenario
track = Circle(radius=2, color=WHITE)
start_point = Dot(track.point_from_proportion(0), color=YELLOW)
runner1 = Dot(track.point_from_proportion(0), color=RED)
runner2 = Dot(track.point_from_proportion(0), color=BLUE)
start_label = Text("Start", font_size=24).next_to(start_point, UP)

self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle), FadeOut(hcf_text), FadeOut(lcm_text), run_time=1)
self.play(Create(track), Create(start_point), Write(start_label), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(runner1), FadeIn(runner2), run_time=1)

# Animate runners moving at different speeds
self.play(
    runner1.animate.move_to(track.point_from_proportion(0.3)),
    runner2.animate.move_to(track.point_from_proportion(0.2)),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(12.8)

# Segment 3 (34.5-55.8s) - Times and LCM introduction
time1 = Text("Runner 1: 15 minutes/lap", color=RED, font_size=28).to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP)
time2 = Text("Runner 2: 20 minutes/lap", color=BLUE, font_size=28).to_edge(LEFT)
lcm_formula = MathTex(r"\text{LCM}(15, 20) = ?", color=YELLOW).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(Write(time1), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(time2), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(lcm_formula), run_time=2)
self.wait(15.3)

# Segment 4 (55.8-82.2s) - LCM explanation
lcm_explanation = VGroup(
    Text("They meet when:", font_size=24),
    Text("• Time is multiple of 15", font_size=24),
    Text("• Time is multiple of 20", font_size=24),
    Text("→ Time = LCM(15,20) = 60 min", font_size=24, color=YELLOW)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(Write(lcm_explanation[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(lcm_explanation[1]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(lcm_explanation[2]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(lcm_explanation[3]), run_time=2)
self.wait(18.4)

# Segment 5 (82.2-147.2s) - HCF basket problem
self.play(
    *[FadeOut(mob) for mob in [track, start_point, runner1, runner2, start_label, 
    time1, time2, lcm_formula, lcm_explanation]], 
    run_time=2
)

basket_title = Text("Basket Distribution Problem", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
apples_text = Text("48 Apples", color=RED, font_size=32).shift(UP * 2 + LEFT * 3)
oranges_text = Text("60 Oranges", color=ORANGE, font_size=32).shift(UP * 2 + RIGHT * 3)

hcf_calc = VGroup(
    Text("Find HCF(48, 60)", font_size=28),
    Text("= 12 baskets possible", font_size=28, color=GREEN)
).arrange(DOWN).shift(DOWN)

self.play(Write(basket_title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(apples_text), Write(oranges_text), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(hcf_calc), run_time=2)

# Create basket visualization
baskets = VGroup(*[
    Rectangle(height=1, width=0.8, color=YELLOW) 
    for _ in range(12)
]).arrange_in_grid(3, 4, buff=0.3).shift(DOWN * 2)

self.play(Create(baskets), run_time=3)
self.wait(56)
